name: E-Shop Tycoon
detailed_description:
"E-Shop Tycoon" is a game about managing an online shopping site in all aspects;

Create your own online shop

Hire employees, expand your office, partner with cargo companies, advertise, buy new buildings, surpass your competitors, grow your popularity and boost your income.
Start from your garage and buy products online. Sign contracts with cargo firms, build your own warehouse and handle logistics. Promote your company to increase prestige and attract more customers. Expand by hitting your goals and selling in larger areas.

Customize your office

Buy and place furniture and decorations to improve employee morale. Make your workspace livelier and shape it just the way you like!

Grow and manage your company

Create new departments, upgrade your servers and warehouses, or hire additional staff to boost operations. Accept deals from other businesses for extra profit!

New departments, new opportunities

Start your own cargo company to eliminate the middleman and maximize profit.
Create a Software Department to secure your site with advanced cybersecurity. Or play dirty—make shady deals with hackers to attack competitors and ruin their prestige!

Meet new people

Encounter and interact with various characters during your journey. Build relationships and discover how they affect your business.

Your users are key to your success

Manage customer requests and gain prestige by keeping them satisfied. Monitor your social media presence and respond to user and corporate posts. Give interviews to media outlets to boost your reputation.
Run marketing campaigns and special events to increase sales—and track how your efforts pay off in the results.

Become the largest online sales company on the market

Grow your network until your products are known worldwide. Outpace the competition—and even acquire some of them!


Don’t stop until you’re number one!

short_description: E-Shop Tycoon is an isometric online shopping company management game. Fill up your warehouses, take orders, hire employees, expand and customize your offices. Protect your site against hackers, improve your reputation on social media. Become the biggest online shopping company in the world!
supported_languages: English, Turkish, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
